items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: Sergio Franchi was at the time, he’s since passed away, he was kind of like a Mario Lanza kind of singer.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a bunch of things, I can’t remember. But what happened was a girl singer came in named Dana Valery and that’s spelled D-A-N-A. A lot of people called her Dana Valerie but it was [pronounced Donna Va lerie] and she was Sergio Franchi’s sister. Her real name was Falstagali, they’re from Johannesberg, South Africa. Sergio Franchi was at the time, he’s since passed away, he was kind of like a Mario Lanza kind of singer. And she was looking for a conductor. She wanted somebody to travel with her. She was…
